prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: C=CC(=O)N1CCC(CNc2ncnc(N)c2-c2ccc(Oc3ccccc3)cc2)CC1
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL5251

Assay A:
  Description: Inhibition of full-length human recombinant BTK using FITC-Ahx-TSELKKVVALYDYMPMNAND-NH2 as substrate measured after 60 mins by caliper assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Assay B:
  Description: Inhibition of human BTK using fluorescein-labeled polyGAT peptide as substrate incubated for 30 mins by FRET assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.55, "error_class": "none", "reason": "Both assays measure IC50 of the same compound against full-length human BTK using similar peptide-substrate-based kinase activity readouts (caliper vs FRET) with high confidence scores, and while the substrates and incubation times differ slightly, these are minor variations that typically yield IC50 values within 0.3 log units for a covalent inhibitor like this acrylamide-based BTK inhibitor."}

parsed.reason: Both assays measure IC50 of the same compound against full-length human BTK using similar peptide-substrate-based kinase activity readouts (caliper vs FRET) with high confidence scores, and while the substrates and incubation times differ slightly, these are minor variations that typically yield IC50 values within 0.3 log units for a covalent inhibitor like this acrylamide-based BTK inhibitor.
